I'm 64 now, been working this patch of ground for 40 years. My wife passed a few years back and the kids are all in Handan working — so it's just me on these 6 mu. I can't do the heavy work like I used to. Plowing, planting, harvesting — I pay the machine operators when their time comes. Everything else I still do myself.

**Wheat (already in the ground from last October)**

I put the wheat in last October like always. About 45 kg of compound fertilizer per mu at planting — the 15-15-15 kind they sell at the agri-supply shop — then closed the drill behind it. We had a dry winter, so I already gave it one winter watering in December and another at returning-green back in March. Next month at jointing I'll topdress about 18 kg of urea per mu and irrigate again if the sky doesn't give us rain. Might need one more at heading if it stays dry.

Old Wang next plot says the wheat looks decent. I'm counting on maybe 420 kg/mu, same as last year. I won't push more fertilizer than that — urea is over 2.5 yuan a kg now, and each watering costs me about 30 yuan a mu at the well meter. I sprayed herbicide (苯磺隆) in early spring, 20 yuan a mu, no bug problem yet. In June I hire the combine — 50 yuan/mu — can't swing a sickle on 6 mu anymore.

**Maize (coming after wheat)**

The window between wheat harvest and maize planting is maybe a week, no time to plow. I hire the no-till planter to drill hybrid seed straight into the stubble. I usually buy 郑单958 or whatever hybrid the station is pushing — about 30 yuan of seed per mu. Base dressing at planting: 40 kg compound. Then at big-trumpet stage, around late July, I topdress urea about 20 kg/mu. If July is dry I'll irrigate once, maybe twice depending on how the corn looks and how much cash I have left. Normal year I get about 480 kg/mu. Combine for harvest too — easier than picking by hand at my age.

I keep things steady year to year. Last year was okay, so I'm not changing much. Being alone with no family labor I can't afford a bad year, but I also can't afford to apply "optimal" rates like the extension people on TV talk about. This is what works on my 6 mu.
